Attesa Coffee is a start-up specialty green coffee sourcing and distribution company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We work directly with producers at the origin to bring our customers (specialty coffee roasters) high-quality coffees safely, on time, and consistently using efficient digital frameworks. We believe in traceability through the chain and are highly committed to transparency towards all our stakeholders.

We are looking for a performance-driven individual with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn to join our team as a Business Development Intern.

The internship will commence in Mid - Aug and we are seeking candidates capable of committing to a full-time schedule of 40 hours per week for a duration of 6 months.

- Assist towards business development and sales of specialty green coffee to roasters / customers within the European market and maintain positive relationships with clients

- Assist in active sales via emails and phone conversations; manage and update CRM database

- Contribute towards conducting analysis of market to identify client requirements

- Assist with preparation of product samples, promotional material for clients

Requirements

- Currently pursuing Bachelor / Masters or equivalent degree

- Ability / preference to work in a dynamic / entrepreneurial environment

- Willingness to learn and implement new sales techniques

- Team player/problem solver, resourceful in creating solutions for customers

- Fluent in both spoken and written English is required

- Dutch / French / Spanish / Italian / Polish / German is a big plus

- Must be based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands

Work in an entrepreneurial and ownership driven environment

- 
Opportunity to grow within a young and dynamic international team

- 
Core knowledge and workings of the agricultural distribution industry

- 
A competitive stipend

- 
Knowledge / interest in specialty coffee

Big ideas and persistent curio

Do you want to work full-time in Beneden Leeuwen as a Forklift Driver? You work in 2 shifts from Monday to Friday, earn up to €19.14 gross per hour, and get plenty of opportunities to develop yourself in logistics. 
About the job 
As a Forklift Driver, you ensure that all orders are ready for transport on time and correctly. You work in a refrigerated warehouse where food products are stored, together with a friendly and close-knit team of colleagues who have been working together for years. 
What will you do as a Forklift Driver? 
Collect orders using an electric pallet truck (EPT), forklift, or reach truck; 
Check products for quality and accuracy; 
Pack orders and prepare them for shipment; 
Process orders administratively in the system; 
Collaborate with your colleagues to keep the process running smoothly. 
You work from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:30. Your evenings and weekends are therefore always free! Additionally, you work in a refrigerated environment due to the products you handle; you will, of course, be provided with appropriate clothing for this. So, you won't get cold at work easily! 
What we offer - A gross hourly wage between €15.13 and €19.14, depending on your work experience; - 28 vacation days for full-time employment;8% holiday allowance, paid out every year in May; - Travel allowance of 0.21 cents per kilometer, from 10 km one-way up to a maximum of 30 km; - Upon good performance, the chance of being taken on permanently by the client with a permanent contract; - Opportunities for personal development and career growth; - Various team-building activities and outings throughout the year. 
About the company

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are available 32 to 40 hours per week
- You are flexible and can perform multiple tasks
- You are physically capable of warehouse work
- You speak Dutch or English

Experience is not required – motivation and commitment are more important. You will receive proper training and learn the job step by step.

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel
